option_relations.rationale: Tumors of the follicular infundibulum are benign adnexal tumors with follicular differentiation, distinct from eccrine poroma.
Clear cell hidradenoma is a benign adnexal tumor of eccrine differentiation, but it is a distinct entity from eccrine poroma with glycogen accumulation, despite both being eccrine tumors.
Clear cell (pale cell) basal cell carcinoma is a malignant epithelial tumor with clear cell features, distinct from the benign eccrine poroma.
Trichoepithelioma is a benign adnexal tumor with follicular differentiation, distinct from eccrine poroma.
